title: 第2章 古人诚不欺我
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
一把将铜镜从穿带上撸了下来，还不等他从坐像肩头跳下来，地宫地面下已经传出“嘎嘎嘎”的机簧声，这动静可比前面触发的机关强多了，地面都在嗡嗡颤动，整个地宫剧烈摇晃了起来。
差点跳下去的道爷一胳膊挂住雕像脑袋，手电迅速打量周围情况，这种情况下误打误撞不是什么好事。
有窸窸窣窣的东西从上面洒落，手电光往上一照，发现穹顶正在裂开。
“猴子，穹顶要坍塌，快走！”道爷吼了声，自己已经纵身从雕像肩头跳下。
可是运气不好，一块巨大的落石直接把他从空中砸了下去。
待他趴在地上呛血抬头时，隐见轰隆隆纷落的石块中，瘦小汉子身形快闪，一个翻滚窜进了进来的甬道中，紧接着眼前一黑，失去了知觉……
脑中纷纷乱乱，头疼欲裂的感觉如潮水般退去后，缓缓睁开双眼，光线昏沉，火光摇影。
目光左右打量，看到了光线来源，一根柱子上斜插的火把，自己似乎身处在一座颇具古风的老旧破庙内，不知是哪，但估计是逃出去的猴子救了自己。
之前被砸趴下的感觉还在，就凭那石头的份量，估计不死也好过不到哪去，能活下来已是万幸。
凭他的经验，人若在重伤的情况下，还是不要有剧烈动作的好，身体虽然感觉不到什么疼痛，也有可能是神经麻木的作用。
先动了动手指，确认十指活动自如，没事！
手掌到胳膊动了动，运转自如，也没事！
又抬了抬双脚，屈膝伸缩大腿，还是没事！
惊喜之下，他双手往地上一撑，正要试试体躯状况，突见一张带着微笑的老脸遮挡在上方视线中，发簪、发髻还有那衣服的风格，一个古装打扮的老头。
“小兄弟，你醒了？看来还真是老夫的运气。”老头微笑道，过手在他肩膀上搬了一把，顺带将他扶了起来。
道爷略保持着警惕，想运功戒备，却发现内力调节不出来，估计是受了重伤的原因，不过坐起扭动了下身子，又没发现身体有什么大碍，只是后脑勺隐隐作痛，似乎遭受过什么重击。
左右看了看破庙内的环境，目光落在老头脸上，问道：“老哥，这是…”话一出口，发现自己的嗓音不对，显得有些稚嫩，估计也是受了伤的原因，干咳一声，继续问道：“这是哪里？”
“老哥？”老头愣了一下，忽呵呵笑道：“年轻人口气不小，好吧，老哥就老哥，有个性我喜欢。这地方具体叫什么我也不清楚，我也没精力去查探，反正就在燕国紫云郡内的一个山窝里。”
燕国紫云郡？道爷茫然一顿，这是哪跟哪？
不由上下打量了一下对方，发现对方胸腹衣服上有大片的血迹，隐隐能闻到血腥味，看脸色有点惨白，似乎受了伤的样子，但眼中神采依然清明，问道：“不知老哥尊姓大名？”

老头笑道：“老夫上清宗弟子东郭浩然。”
道爷又是一愣，字听清楚了，但是没听明白什么意思，再次上下打量对方，穿着古装，话中带着古意，这位不会是入戏太深了吧？你要扮古人也要扮像一点好不好，古人操着一口字正腔圆的普通话？他怀疑有人在耍他，扭头四处喊道：“猴子！猴子……”
老头也愣了下，道：“我也刚到，没看到什么猴子，这附近的山林中有猴子吗？”
没猴子的响应，自己怎会出现在这里是个疑问，但能把自己从那古墓里弄出来的人肯定不简单，道爷沉声道：“老哥，不知哪条道上混的？”
老头笑道：“上清宗自然是正道。”
道爷冷笑一声，“老哥，再这样闹就没意思了，“好！”老头点头道：“我身受重伤，时间不多了，你也许不明白什么意思，但只需记得一点，上清宗也在这紫云郡内，离此大概有三百余里，这山下不远处有条河，漂流直下，抵达一处断崖瀑布时可停下，在那钟灵毓秀之地便是上清宗所在，记清了吗？”
话毕，老头盘膝坐正，单掌在胸前柔和旋转一推。
道爷瞬间大惊失色，发现自己被一股无形力道挟持，钳制的一动不能动，整个人轻轻飘离了地面，心中可谓震惊，想不到这世上竟有内力如此高深之人，简直高深到了他无法想象的地步，本以为自己修为在江湖上已经算是顶尖高手，如今看来不过是米粒之珠与皓月争辉，古语曰天外有天人外有人，古人诚不欺我！

content_en:
He took off the bronze mirror from the belt, and before he could jump down from the shoulder of the statue, the sound of a machine spring could be heard from under the ground of the underground palace. This sound was much stronger than the mechanism triggered earlier. The ground was buzzing and trembling, and the entire underground palace was shaking violently.
Master Tao, who almost jumped down, hung the statue's head with one arm and quickly looked at the surrounding situation with his flashlight. In this case, an accidental collision is not a good thing.
There were rustling things falling from above. When the flashlight shined upward, I found that the dome was cracking.
"Monkey, the dome is about to collapse, hurry up!" Dao Ye roared, and he jumped off the shoulder of the statue.
But as luck would have it, a huge falling rock knocked him straight out of the air.
When he lay on the ground, choking on blood, and raised his head, he could see a thin man dodging among the rumbling stones, and rolled into the corridor. Then his vision went dark, and he lost consciousness...
His mind was in turmoil, and after the splitting headache receded like a tide, he slowly opened his eyes, the light was dim, and the firelight flickered.
Looking around, he saw the source of the light, a torch stuck diagonally on a pillar. He seemed to be in an old ruined temple with an ancient style. He didn't know where it was, but he was probably saved by the monkey who escaped.
The feeling of being knocked down before was still there. Based on the weight of the stone, it would probably be no better than death. I was lucky to survive.
Based on his experience, if a person is seriously injured, it is better not to make strenuous movements. Although the body does not feel any pain, it may be due to nerve numbness.
Move your fingers first to make sure they can move freely and everything is fine!
I moved from my palms to my arms, and they moved freely, and it was okay!
I lifted my feet again, bent my knees and stretched my thighs, but it was still fine!
Surprised, he put his hands on the ground and was about to test his physical condition when he suddenly saw an old smiling face blocking the view above. The hairpin, bun and the style of the clothes made him look like an old man dressed in ancient costume.
"Little brother, are you awake? It seems that I am really lucky." The old man smiled, put a hand on his shoulder, and helped him up.
Dao Ye remained vigilant for a while, trying to use his energy to be on guard, but found that he couldn't regulate his internal energy, which was probably due to a serious injury. However, he sat up and twisted his body, but found nothing serious about his body. There was only a dull pain in the back of his head, as if he had suffered a heavy blow.
He looked around at the environment in the ruined temple, then his eyes fell on the old man's face and asked: "Brother, this is..." As soon as he said the words, he found that his voice was wrong and seemed a little immature. It was probably because of the injury. He coughed dryly and continued to ask: "Where is this?"
"Brother?" The old man was stunned for a moment, then he laughed and said: "Young people have a good reputation. Well, I'm just a brother. I like his personality. I don't know the exact name of this place, and I don't have the energy to investigate. Anyway, it's in a mountain nest in Ziyun County of Yan State."
Ziyun County of Yan State? The Taoist Master was at a loss, where is this?
I couldn't help but look the other person up and down, and found that there were large blood stains on the other person's chest and abdomen clothes, and I could faintly smell the smell of blood. His face was a little pale, as if he had been injured, but his eyes were still clear, and he asked: "I don't know what your name is, brother?"
The old man smiled and said: "I am a disciple of the Shangqing Sect, Dongguo Haoran."
Master Dao was stunned again. He heard the words clearly, but didn't understand what they meant. He looked at the other person up and down again. He was wearing ancient clothes and his words had ancient meanings. Could this person be too into the drama? If you want to pretend to be an ancient person, why don't you also pretend to be a little bit like the ancient person who spoke Mandarin with a clear accent? He suspected that someone was playing a trick on him, so he turned around and shouted: "Monkey! Monkey..."
The old man was also stunned for a moment and said: "I just arrived and I didn't see any monkeys. Are there any monkeys in the mountains and forests nearby?"
Without the monkey's response, how could I have appeared here?This is a question, but it is definitely not easy to get yourself out of that ancient tomb. Master Dao said in a deep voice: "Brother, I wonder which way did you get mixed up?"
The old man smiled and said: "The Shangqing Sect is naturally the right path."
Master Dao sneered, "Brother, it won't be fun to make trouble like this anymore," Okay! "The old man nodded and said: "I was seriously injured and I don't have much time. You may not understand what I mean, but you just need to remember one thing. The Shangqing Sect is also in Ziyun County, about three hundred miles away. There is a river not far from the mountain, which floats straight down. You can stop when you reach a cliff waterfall. The place with beautiful bells and graces is where the Shangqing Sect is. Do you remember clearly? "
After finishing speaking, the old man sat upright with his legs crossed, and gently pushed with one palm in front of his chest.
Master Dao was shocked instantly. He found that he was held hostage by an invisible force, and he could not move. His whole body floated gently off the ground. He was shocked. He never thought that there could be someone with such profound inner strength in this world. It was simply He was so advanced that he couldn't imagine it. He originally thought that his cultivation was considered to be the top master in the world, but now it seems that he is just a grain of rice competing with the bright moon. As the old saying goes, there is a world outside the sky, and there are people outside the world. The ancients do not deceive me!
